title.purpose: Panel header h2 — one per section.

body.purpose: Default reading size for descriptions, findings, table cells.

label.purpose: Uppercase group labels, table headers, kv field names — always on text-caption.

mono.purpose: Every hex address, hash, offset, and numeric table column; tabular-nums.

motion.name: spin
motion.value: spin 0.9s linear infinite (disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)
motion.purpose: Loader2 icon on the primary button while an AI report is generating.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action in the app — 'Generate report' inside the AI panel. Only button that takes the AI accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: #a684ff; color: #0a0b0e; border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b9dff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #191c23; color: #e8eaed; border: 1px solid #2b303b; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; font-size: 0.82rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1c2029; border-color: #3a4150; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b9dff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Severity Pill
components.description: Icon + label + color together — never color alone. High/medium/low variants share this shape.
components.html: High
components.css: .ds-severity-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 0.12rem 0.45rem; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-severity-pill--high { background: #2a1417; color: #f2555a; } .ds-severity-pill--medium { background: #2a2116; color: #e8a33d; } .ds-severity-pill--low { background: #191c23; color: #a3aab8; }

components.name: Flag Tag
components.description: Flags a table row's value as suspicious (section anomalies, suspicious-keyword strings).
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 0.1rem 0.4rem; border-radius: 4px; background: #191c23; color: #a3aab8; border: 1px solid #2b303b; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tag--flag { background: #2a2116; color: #e8a33d; border-color: rgba(232,163,61,0.35); }

components.name: Nav Rail Item
components.description: Section rail row: icon + label + optional severity-aware count badge. Active state is solid-filled.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem; border: none; background: transparent; color: #a3aab8; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.85rem; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #1c2029; color: #e8eaed; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: #191c23; color: #e8eaed; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b9dff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: AI Nav Item
components.description: The one nav item that carries the AI accent at rest and when active — the system's sole scoped exception.
components.css: .ds-nav-item-ai { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem; border: none; background: transparent; color: #a684ff; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.85rem; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item-ai--active { background: #1a1530; }

components.name: Dropzone
components.description: The entire pre-load surface — centered, dashed border, no nav rail visible until a file is parsed.
components.html:
Drop a Windows PE file here, or click to browse

Parsing runs entirely in your browser. The file is never uploaded anywhere.
components.css: .ds-dropzone { width: min(560px, 100%); border: 1px dashed #3a4150; border-radius: 6px; padding: 3rem 2rem; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; background: #111318; color: #6b7280; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-dropzone:hover { border-color: #5b9dff; background: #191c23; } .ds-dropzone__title { margin: 0 0 0.35rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #e8eaed; } .ds-dropzone__subtitle { margin: 0; color: #a3aab8; font-size: 0.85rem; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: The core data-density primitive — property tables for sections, exports, strings. Uppercase caption headers, tabular-nums cells, flagged-row tint.
components.css: .ds-data-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.85rem; } .ds-data-table th { text-align: left; padding: 0.5rem 0.7rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #2b303b; color: #838a99; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-data-table td { padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #21252e; vertical-align: top; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-data-table tr:hover td { background: #1c2029; } .ds-data-table__row--flagged td { background: #2a2116; } .ds-mono { font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', 'JetBrains Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.85em; }

narrative.overview:
BinSight reads as a debugger console, not a marketing surface: near-black panel tiers, a fixed left-hand section rail, and dense property tables that assume the reader is a reverse engineer who already knows what RVA, entropy, and TLS callbacks mean. The register is IDA/Ghidra/x64dbg lineage — restrained neutral grays, every address and hash in monospace with tabular numerals, and color spent as signal rather than decoration. Nothing about the surface performs enthusiasm; it just lays out the data and gets out of the way.

Two disciplines hold the world together. First, state is never color-only — every severity indicator pairs an icon and a text label with its color (SeverityPill, nav badges), so the system reads correctly for a colorblind analyst and at a glance for everyone else. Second, color is spent sparingly: severity red/amber/gray is reserved for real flags and never leaks into chrome, and the single violet accent is confined to the AI Report section by rule, not by accident — verified in the shipped CSS, --ai-accent and its -bg/-border pairs appear in exactly one component file (AiReportPanel.tsx) and the AI nav item's own selectors.

There are no shadows anywhere in this system. Depth is conveyed entirely by a five-step background ladder (--bg-shell to --bg-panel to --bg-elevated to --bg-hover, plus a recessed --bg-inset for form controls) and 1px borders — a flat, tonal-layering world, consistent with the analyst-tool references it draws from.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, near-black panel tiers with no drop shadows — depth is tonal, not lifted.
Every address, hash, offset, and byte count is monospace with tabular numerals.
Severity color (red/amber/gray) is reserved exclusively for real heuristic flags; it never decorates chrome.
One violet accent (--ai-accent) exists, and it appears nowhere outside the AI Report nav item and panel.
State is always icon + label + color together — never color alone.

rules.name: The Caption-vs-Tertiary Rule
rules.body: --text-tertiary (#6b7280) only meets a 3:1 contrast floor and is reserved for decorative, icon-only elements. Any caption-weight text that is actually read uses --text-caption (#838a99, 5.36:1) instead. This split exists because the finish-review pass caught caption text failing the 4.5:1 body-text floor on --text-tertiary; don't collapse the two tokens back into one.

rules.name: The Confined Accent Rule
rules.body: --ai-accent and its -bg/-border pairs are used only inside the AI Report nav item and the AI Report panel. No other button, link, or chrome element may take the violet — its scarcity is what keeps the dashboard, not the AI feature, reading as the product.

rules.name: The Real-Severity Rule
rules.body: A nav badge or table highlight only takes an alarm color (red/amber) when it is backed by an actual HeuristicSeverity value. A plain item count with no severity of its own renders in the neutral badge tone, never red, so that red keeps meaning 'real severity' everywhere it appears.

rules.name: The Tabular-Nums Rule
rules.body: Any numeric or hex value in a data table or key/value list gets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so stacked numbers align vertically.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No component uses box-shadow, filter: drop-shadow, or backdrop-filter. Depth is read entirely from background-tier and border-tier steps.

dos: Do pair every state indicator with an icon and a text label alongside its color — never rely on color alone (severity pills, nav badges).
Do use the monospace stack with tabular numerals for every address, hash, offset, and byte count.
Do keep --ai-accent confined to the AI Report nav item and panel; see The Confined Accent Rule.
Do use --text-caption (not --text-tertiary) for any caption-weight text that is actually read continuously (table headers, field labels, hints) — reserve --text-tertiary for decorative icons only.
Do convey depth with the background-tier and border-tier ladders, never with shadows.
donts: Don't apply severity red/amber to a nav badge or table highlight that isn't backed by a real HeuristicSeverity value — plain counts stay neutral gray.
Don't introduce a second saturated accent color; the system's entire 'foreignness' budget is spent on one violet, scoped to one feature.
Don't add box-shadow, drop-shadow, or backdrop-filter anywhere — this system is flat by rule, not by omission.
Don't reuse --text-tertiary for body, label, or hint copy that must clear a 4.5:1 contrast floor — it only clears 3:1 and is reserved for decorative icons.
